t_advice_summary_textbox.text: some of the pointed hates are better than the flat ones. yellow, and pink had higher points, but sometimes you may have 2 flat or 2 pointed hats and have to develop your own strategy to do well.

vb_textbox.text: I found that it is important to pay attention to the shape of the hat as well as the color. once you figure out which ones give the most mushrooms, you will receive a higher score.
